english: As it is, they have been drilling for sixteen hours and they still have a long way to go.
text: As it is 把话从“原本几个小时就好”的假想拉回实际进度。have been drilling 计算持续施工的过程，have a long way to go 则说明离完成还远；这里的 way 不一定是实际行走的路程。
